---
title: "Data"
---

Source files and analysis outputs are about 185 GB and are kept outside the repository.
The code reaches them through one setting, `DATA_ROOT`.

## Data root

Resolution order, first match wins:

1. environment variable `MS_FORESTS_VPD_DATA`
2. `DATA_ROOT` in `config/settings.local.yaml`, not under version control
3. `DATA_ROOT` in `config/settings.yaml`, the committed default

```bash
# Windows PowerShell
$env:MS_FORESTS_VPD_DATA = "D:/ms-forests-vpd-data"

# macOS / Linux
export MS_FORESTS_VPD_DATA=/data/ms-forests-vpd-data
```

Or in `config/settings.local.yaml`:

```yaml
DATA_ROOT: D:/ms-forests-vpd-data
```

All other paths in `config/settings.yaml` are relative to `DATA_ROOT` and resolved by
`src/paths.py`, which raises on import if the folder is missing.

## Folder layout

```
<DATA_ROOT>/
└── data/
    ├── 00_raw/
    │   ├── ameriflux/
    │   ├── fluxnet_from_carbonportal/
    │   ├── fluxnet_from_fluxnetorg/
    │   ├── from-fluxnet-shuttle/
    │   └── japanflux/
    └── outputs/
        ├── 10_datasets/
        ├── 20_subsets/
        ├── 30_shap/
        ├── 40_aggregation/
        ├── 50_plots/
        └── 80_info/
```

Each `00_raw/<source>/` folder holds the unpacked site archives plus `0-info/` with the
site metadata file. File name patterns per source are in `config/settings.yaml`.

## Source datasets

Half-hourly FLUXNET-formatted files from five sources. Where a site appears in more than
one, the higher-priority source wins and the others extend the record backwards
(`src/files.py::create_parquet_files`).

| Source | Access |
|--------|--------|
| FLUXNET-SHUTTLE | <https://fluxnet.org/> |
| FLUXNET2015 (ICOS Carbon Portal) | <https://www.icos-cp.eu/> |
| FLUXNET2015 (fluxnet.org) | <https://fluxnet.org/data/fluxnet2015-dataset/> |
| AmeriFlux FLUXNET | <https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/> |
| JapanFlux2024 | <https://www.japanflux.org/> |

All five require registration, so the raw files are not redistributed here.

## Deposited outputs

The per-site subsets (`20_subsets/`), the aggregation outputs (`40_aggregation/`), the
figure data files and the sensitivity outputs (`80_info/`) are deposited in the ETH
Research Collection: <https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-c-000798579> [DEPOSIT PENDING: link
goes live with the final upload]. Unpacked into `outputs/`, they allow every stage from
`30_shap` onward and every figure to run without the raw source files.

## Entry points

- Everything from `30_shap` onward runs from `outputs/20_subsets/`, one small parquet
  file per site. Rebuilding those from raw data is needed only if the site selection or
  the filtering changes.
- The figure scripts read `outputs/40_aggregation/`, `outputs/30_shap/` and
  `outputs/80_info/` and fit no model.

## ERA5 credentials

Needed only for scripts `16a` to `16d`, which rebuild the climate normals.

- Google Earth Engine (`16a`, `16b`): an Earth Engine account and cloud project;
  authenticate once with `earthengine authenticate`.
- Copernicus Climate Data Store (`16c`, `16d`): a CDS account and an API key in
  `~/.cdsapirc`. Requests are queued server-side and can take hours.

Script `17` merges whatever is present, see [Methods](methods.qmd#era5-climate-normals).
